race.description: Jockeys & Trainers Re-Union Race Day 29 Aug Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: TARA KODA (13) had no option but to go back last start with a struggling tenth over 1600m at Coffs Harbour. Assess on the eye-catching run two back when going under narrowly when second over 1600m. Well placed today at the good odds. AWARDED GLORY (7) coming along nicely this time in and got the Maiden win out of the way here three back over the 1720m. Had to make a couple of runs when a tenacious second over 1600m at Coffs Harbour in C2 class. Senior rider goes on from a good gate and can take care of this field. SECRET KEEPER (8) has disappointed at his last two outings and assess on the good first up effort when second at Port Macquarie. Gets a better set-up for this and the cross-over nose band goes on. OTTOMAN EMPIRE (11) was brave last start with the 60.5kg when eighth over 1900m at Casino. Sharp drop in weight today on a quick backup.
